Travel 2 tiles to creek.
— Moving water —
Cold, clear, moving. The best thing you've seen all day.
Something moves out there — the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up.
You see smoke on the horizon. Stonebridge — 9 people, 7 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 5 plants — 5 new to you. They've been here the whole time.

Travel 1 tile to creek.
— Moving water —
The water is cold enough to hurt your teeth. Downstream the creek bends out of sight, and you want to follow it. That's the problem with creeks.
You see smoke on the horizon. Emberhold — 9 people, 7 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 4 plants — 4 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
The creek runs fast here — no crossing without a bridge or a swim.
🪨 Zoe pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (7 stone now.)
Ruth doesn't bother arguing anymore. By dusk the Fish crews are taking orders from them, and nobody quite remembers when it changed.
The creek runs fast here — no crossing without a bridge or a swim.

Travel 1 tile to creek.
— Moving water —
A kingfisher works the far bank, patient as a tax collector. It catches something silver and is gone before you can envy it properly.

🌿 Ruth checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~11 days of fresh on hand… leaves the fish nets standing and turns to the water run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
